_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. elevenmusic.io declares a shadcn-style semantic token layer in its Next.js bundles and paints dark by default (html.dark); the footer theme control remaps the same roles to a warm-paper light theme. Declared roles become var leaves resolved per theme; scales identical in both themes live in core; geometry and the measured type ramp are measured leaves from raw/components-computed.json.
